cards.ex: I tried to remember the actor's name, but I completely drew a blank.
cards.exUz: Aktyorning ismini eslashga harakat qildim, lekin butunlay esdan chiqardim.
cards.uzDef: Nimadir haqida eslay olmaslik yoki hech qanday fikrga kelmaslik.

cards.ex: He's a die-hard fan of that indie band; he's seen them ten times.
cards.exUz: U o'sha indie guruhining ashaddiy muxlisi; u ularni o'n marta ko'rgan.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsaning juda sodiq va ishtiyoqli muxlisi.

cards.ex: The band needs to get their act together if they want to play at the festival.
cards.exUz: Agar guruh festivalda o'ynamoqchi bo'lsa, ular o'zlarini tartibga solishlari kerak.
cards.uzDef: Tartibli va mas'uliyatli bo'lishni boshlash.

cards.ex: Even with all those famous actors, she stole the scene in every movie she was in.
cards.exUz: Barcha mashhur aktyorlar bilan birga u har bir filmida diqqatni tortdi.
cards.uzDef: Boshqalardan ko'ra ko'proq diqqatni jalb qilmoq.

cards.ex: The movie was a box office bomb, even though it had a huge budget.
cards.exUz: Film katta byudjetga ega bo'lishiga qaramay, kassada muvaffaqiyatsizlikka uchradi.
cards.uzDef: Katta muvaffaqiyatsizlikka uchragan film.

cards.ex: That low-budget horror film has gained a cult following over the years.
cards.exUz: Bu arzon qo'rqinchli film yillar davomida o'zining maxsus muxlislar guruhiga ega bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Kichik, lekin juda sodiq muxlislar guruhi.

cards.ex: After winning the award, she was constantly in the spotlight.
cards.exUz: Mukofotni yutgandan so'ng, u doimo diqqat markazida edi.
cards.uzDef: Ommaviy e'tibor markazida bo'lish.

cards.ex: That band was a one-hit wonder; no one remembers them now.
cards.exUz: Bu guruh faqat bitta hitning muallifi edi; hozir ularni hech kim eslamaydi.
cards.uzDef: Faqat bitta mashhur qo'shiq bilan tanilgan artist.

cards.ex: I started to tune out during the long acceptance speech.
cards.exUz: Men uzoq qabul nutqi paytida diqqatni yo'qota boshladim.
cards.uzDef: Diqqatni yo'qotish yoki e'tibor bermaslik.

cards.ex: The crowd was so enthusiastic that the band gave an encore performance.
cards.exUz: Tomoshabinlar shunchalik hayajonlanganki, guruh yana bir bor ijro etdi.
cards.uzDef: Tomoshabinlarning talabiga binoan yana bir bor ijro etish.

cards.ex: Replacing the lead actor is going to be a tough act.
cards.exUz: Bosh rolni almashtirish juda qiyin vazifa bo'ladi.
cards.uzDef: Bajarish qiyin bo'lgan ish yoki vazifa.

cards.ex: It took me a while to get a handle on the new software for editing.
cards.exUz: Tahrirlash uchun yangi dasturni o'zlashtirish uchun biroz vaqt kerak bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsani tushunish va nazorat qilishni boshlash.

cards.ex: Reality TV is my guilty pleasure.
cards.exUz: Realiti-shoular mening yashirin zavqim.
cards.uzDef: Sizga yoqadigan, lekin biroz uyaladigan narsa.

cards.ex: He was just putting on a show for the cameras.
cards.exUz: U shunchaki kameralar uchun ko'rsatuv uyushtirayotgan edi.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsani qasddan, ko'rsatish uchun qilish.

cards.ex: We need to make sure everyone is on the same page before we start the project.
cards.exUz: Loyihani boshlashdan oldin hamma bir xil fikrda ekanligiga ishonch hosil qilishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Bir xil narsani tushunish va kelishish.

cards.ex: I didn't want to steal her thunder by announcing my news at her party.
cards.exUz: Men uning ziyofatida o'z yangiliklarimni e'lon qilib, uning shon-shuhratini o'g'irlashni xohlamadim.
cards.uzDef: Kimnidir nufuzini yo'qotishiga sabab bo'lish.

cards.ex: His predecessor was so successful, he's going to be a hard act to follow.
cards.exUz: Uning o'tmishdoshi juda muvaffaqiyatli edi, unga o'xshab ishlash juda qiyin bo'ladi.
cards.uzDef: Kimdir yaxshi ishlagandan keyin, shunga o'xshash ishlash juda qiyin.

cards.ex: Her performance was a showstopper; the audience loved it.
cards.exUz: Uning chiqishi hayratga soluvchi edi; tomoshabinlar uni yaxshi ko'rdilar.
cards.uzDef: Juda ta'sirli yoki hayratlanarli chiqish.

cards.ex: You've worked so hard; break a leg tonight!
cards.exUz: Siz juda ko'p mehnat qildingiz; bugun kechqurun omad!
cards.uzDef: Aktyorlarga sahna oldidan omad tilash.

cards.ex: The comedian brought down the house with his jokes.
cards.exUz: Komik o'z hazillari bilan tomoshabinlarni qattiq kuldirdi.
cards.uzDef: Tomoshabinlarni qattiq kuldirmoq yoki olqishlatmoq.

cards.ex: The understudy was waiting in the wings, ready to go on if needed.
cards.exUz: Zaxira aktyor kerak bo'lsa sahnaga chiqishga tayyor holda sahna ortida kutib turardi.
cards.uzDef: Sahna ortida, keyingi chiqishga tayyorlanib turish.

cards.ex: Several young actors are waiting in the wings, hoping for their big break.
cards.exUz: Bir nechta yosh aktyorlar o'zlarining katta muvaffaqiyatini kutishmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Nimadir sodir bo'lishini kutish yoki tayyorlanib turish.

cards.ex: The band went out of their way to make the concert special for the fans.
cards.exUz: Guruh muxlislar uchun konsertni maxsus qilish uchun bor kuchini sarf qildi.
cards.uzDef: Kimdir uchun g'ayrioddiy sa'y-harakatlarni amalga oshirish.

cards.ex: I can't wait to see that movie on the big screen.
cards.exUz: Men bu filmni katta ekranda ko'rishni sabrsizlik bilan kutyapman.
cards.uzDef: Kinoteatr ekranida.

cards.ex: The new song is expected to be a smash hit.
cards.exUz: Yangi qo'shiq katta muvaffaqiyatga erishishi kutilmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Katta muvaffaqiyatga erishmoq.

cards.ex: The band played to a sell-out crowd last night.
cards.exUz: Guruh kecha to'liq zalda o'ynadi.
cards.uzDef: Barcha chiptalar sotilgan zal.

cards.ex: That new dance is all the rage at parties right now.
cards.exUz: Bu yangi raqs hozir partiyalarda juda mashhur.
cards.uzDef: Hozirda juda mashhur va urfdagi narsa.

cards.ex: The audience got carried away and started singing along with the band.
cards.exUz: Tomoshabinlar hissiyotga berilib, guruh bilan birga qo'shiq ayta boshladilar.
cards.uzDef: Hissiyotga berilib, nazoratni yo'qotish.

cards.ex: Let me set the scene: it was a dark and stormy night...
cards.exUz: Keling, vaziyatni tasvirlab beray: tun qorong'u va bo'ronli edi...
cards.uzDef: Hikoya yoki voqea uchun vaziyatni batafsil tasvirlash.

cards.ex: That new thriller was a real page-turner; I finished it in one sitting!
cards.exUz: O'sha yangi triller juda qiziqarli kitob edi; men uni bir o'tirishda tugatdim!
cards.uzDef: Juda qiziqarli kitob, o'qishni to'xtatish qiyin.
